name: Axon Circuit, Inc.

about:
Axon Circuit, Inc. is a printed circuit board manufacturer headquartered in Tampa, Florida. The company was founded in 1990 and has operated continuously in the Southeast United States for over three decades.

The firm produces rigid PCBs ranging from single-sided and double-sided boards to multilayer constructions up to 16 layers. Its capabilities include fine-line and surface-mount technology pitches, board thicknesses from 0.008 to 0.250 inches, carbon ink contacts, oversized multilayer panels, ball grid array patterns, blind and buried vias, peelable and water-soluble masks, plated slots and edges, epoxy via plug, and controlled impedance. Materials stocked encompass FR-4, high-temperature FR-4 equivalents, Rogers, Taconic, Arlon, polyimide, Teflon, and GETEK laminates. Surface finishes offered are solder mask over bare copper, hot air solder leveling, electroless nickel/gold (including bondable gold), electroless white tin, electroless silver, screenable silver and carbon, and heavy copper layers. The 25,000-square-foot facility employs more than 40 people and has produced over 100 million rigid PCBs, with annual revenue exceeding $5 million. The company owns its equipment and recently invested over $1 million in new fabrication and testing systems.

Axon Circuit serves customers in communications, instrumentation and controls, consumer electronics, medical devices, automotive, and military sectors. Its clientele is primarily business-to-business, built largely through referrals.

The company emphasizes an attitude of continuous improvement, personalized service, and on-time delivery. It maintains a supplier performance guarantee, offers competitive domestic and offshore quotes, and operates an internal waste treatment and reverse osmosis system to reduce environmental impact. ITAR certification and compliance with ISO 9001:2015, IPC-A-600 Class III, and UL listing support its work in regulated markets.
